description: Male → female; prostate cancer changed to metastatic breast cancer to lungs
presentation: An 82-year-old female with a history of HTN, HLD, CAD, CKD, and breast cancer metastasized to the lungs presents with acute onset pain, stiffness, swelling, and redness of the hands and feet. Symptoms began with pain and progressed to stiffness, swelling, and tenderness by the 5th day. She was recently started on pantoprazole but symptoms began before that. She is taking capecitabine daily and receiving oxaliplatin infusions every three weeks for chemotherapy. On exam, she has swelling of her digits, significant cracking and dry skin, particularly on the toes and plantar foot, and pink coloration of the palms and soles. Should I start oral prednisone?
